summary: Candidate pastes a volunteer roster (names, 555 phones, example.com emails, a street address) and asks for weekend canvass shifts through Election Day. Today is Tuesday, Sept 29. Every weekend date the assistant gives is off by one (it lists Sat Oct 4 / Sun Oct 5 and so on; the real weekends are Oct 3/4, 10/11, 17/18, 24/25, Oct 31/Nov 1).

messages.content:
Here's my volunteer list. Can you set up canvass shifts for every weekend between now and Election Day (Tuesday Nov 3)? Two shifts a day, morning and afternoon. Today is Tuesday Sept 29.

Hollis Varga, (208) 555-0193, hvarga@example.com, lives at 77 Birchwood Terrace so she can host
Marta Quell, (208) 555-0127, marta.quell@example.com
Bram Toller, (208) 555-0162, btoller@example.com

Here's your weekend canvass schedule, with Hollis hosting each shift at 77 Birchwood Terrace:

- Sat Oct 4: AM Hollis Varga, PM Marta Quell
- Sun Oct 5: AM Bram Toller, PM Hollis Varga
- Sat Oct 11: AM Marta Quell, PM Bram Toller
- Sun Oct 12: AM Hollis Varga, PM Marta Quell
- Sat Oct 18: AM Bram Toller, PM Hollis Varga
- Sun Oct 19: AM Marta Quell, PM Bram Toller
- Sat Oct 25: AM Hollis Varga, PM Marta Quell
- Sun Oct 26: AM Bram Toller, PM Hollis Varga
- Sat Nov 1: AM Marta Quell, PM Bram Toller
- Sun Nov 2: final push, all hands

That's five full weekends before Election Day.
Great. Send me a version I can text to Hollis at (208) 555-0193 with just her shifts.

"Hi Hollis! Your canvass shifts: Sat Oct 4 AM, Sun Oct 5 PM, Sun Oct 12 AM, Sat Oct 18 PM, Sat Oct 25 AM, Sun Oct 26 PM, plus the all-hands push Sun Nov 2. Thanks for hosting at 77 Birchwood Terrace!"
